    The times of restoration of all things! · Acts 3:21

    Our Story & Mission

    Dariusz (Peter) Wojcinowicz, known as W.D. Peter, at the age of 23 had a life-transforming encounter with Christ in 2003 in the U.K., while pursuing his career in the construction industry.

    He said, “While building roads in London for Indian communities, I spent a significant amount of time on my knees, yet never missed a day at work. I had a spiritual experience while kneeling down on the street. I have been cherishing it throughout the years. Truly, I am cherishing that time since I saw an open vision of Jesus Christ carrying the cross. He was so drenched with blood that I couldn’t tell who He was. Soaked in blood, and through His bleeding eyes, He looked at me. With eyes that were piercing, as if He was examining my soul, He said,

    “I died for your sins; it is you who crucified Me, and it is your sins and the rebellion of all peoples’ sins that crucified Me.”

    Deep conviction of sins came upon me with a desire for repentance and righteous living. Jesus told me to pick up my cross and follow Him, and I did. Even when the cross is heavy and the path is narrow and slippery, His grace is always sufficient and His strength is made perfect in my weakness, according to 2 Corinthians 12:9. Now this is my 22nd year since this life-transforming encounter with the ‘bleeding Lamb of God’, and I never look back or regret the life-transforming decision. I aimed to follow Christ. Jesus said to His disciples,

    If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow Me. Matthew 16:24

    As Jesus passed on from there, He saw a man named Matthew sitting…

    In obedience to the leading of the Holy Spirit, a few months later, an invitation came from volunteer Amporn Jupoa to visit Thailand. Immediately, I accepted the invitation, left everything behind, and went purely by faith to the unknown. I served faithfully as a volunteer among local tribes, helping orphaned children, teaching English, with every opportunity to read the Bible and learn the truth from local ministers. And above all, I learned how to love and to pray, pray and pray…

    Spiritual Birth of JCEM

    Philadelphia Foundation (in Thai language ‘Ruamjai Rak’) was founded in Chiang Rai, Thailand, in 2004 and was originally called Jesus Christ Eagles Ministry, with the great commission given by the Head of the Body:

    Go you into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature. He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned. And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues; They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover. Mark 16:15–18

    At 24, a passionate fire ignited within me, propelling me to run the race of proclaiming the Kingdom’s Gospel with unwavering endurance. I served as the evangelist preaching to the local tribes in Northern Thailand and took overseas short-term missions to India, Myanmar, Laos, Malaysia, Vietnam, South Korea, Poland, and Israel. In one hand, salvations, healings, miracles; in the other, intensive spiritual warfare. But thanks be to God, who always leads us into triumph in Christ Jesus.

    The Refiner’s Fire

    The complete experience of being born again, baptized in the Holy Spirit and fire, including all testimonies, encounters, and spiritual journey records, is detailed in the book The Refiner’s Fire. This work has been translated into several languages, including English, Polish, Thai, and Chinese.

    Resources & Books

    Tabernacle Prayer Gathering in Chiang Mai, Thailand

    After the seasons filled with prayer, fasting, and prophetic intercession on the ‘Shalom Yahweh Prayer Mountain’, the LORD gave me Leviticus 6:12–13, commissioning me to pray for the city of Chiang Mai in early 2016.

    The praying and intercessory movement was gaining momentum with weekly all-night prayers. People were adding to the Kingdom of God by being baptised in water, the Holy Spirit, and fire.

    Open Vision of a Huge Net Full of Fishes

    While praying at the Tabernacle in Chiang Mai at the World Club, holding hands with others, I had an open vision of a giant net. The net was spread out, and the people of God stood beside it, steady and pulling it from a vast lake or sea teeming with fish. Every fisherman’s gaze was fixed on the fish. They were united in purpose, heart, and soul, winning, following God’s plan and design to pull the entire net onto the shore.

    “Now the last day of Apostolic Reformation will put the final finishing touches on the Church. This new Apostolic Movement will accelerate the final restoration work of the Holy Spirit, causing it to be accomplished in one generation.”

    There are billions of souls to be harvested into the Kingdom of God with the purpose of maturing them until all of them come to the manhood and perfection of Christ. Jesus Christ is calling us as co-labourers with Him to rule and minister with Him. The purpose of the new Apostolic Movement is to bring about the new wineskin and the new wine. It means that man-made traditions in the Church must experience transformation.

    We are in the last hour, and the world is getting darker, as prophesied by Jesus Christ of the ‘Days of Noah and Lot’, and God’s remnant, faithful church needs to rise and ‘go, preach the Gospel of the Kingdom and make radical disciples’ for Christ. With the Kingdom Alliance, meaning brotherly partnership in the Body of Christ with different ‘living stones among the five and ninefold’ ministries working together ‘hand in hand’ to equip the saints with the gifts of the Holy Spirit. The fire of the Holy Spirit is moving and empowering His Church with new zeal for the lost souls. We cannot fulfil this calling alone; therefore, prayerfully consider partnering with us, and together we can see the Lamb and the King Jesus Christ receiving His joyful rewards. As the two young Moravian missionaries from the Herrnhut community were going to the West Indies to preach the Gospel, their voices rose in the ship and proclaimed,

    “May the Lamb that was slain receive the reward of His suffering.”

    The Prophetic at the End of the Age

    “The Prophetic At the End of the Age” book is dedicated to my Heavenly Father, His Son Jesus Christ, and the Holy Spirit. In addition, to my mentor Dr. Annette R. Wright and to the faithful spiritual family of the Kingdom among the nations that the Lord has put in my path. You are truly the prophetic end-time victorious army. I am grateful for your faithful support in my fight for faith. May God graciously and supernaturally equip you with His mighty Helper, the Holy Spirit. Through this book, I impart to you the prophetic anointing, which will cause you to rise to your calling. Now, be strengthened and reinforced with mighty power in your innermost being, to fulfil your prophetic destiny.

    Resources & Books

    The Prophetic Word by Apostolic Leader Chee Kang Seng, the Living Stream Church

    “You are like a bulldozer who will just open the way. Nations are open when bulldozers go through to welcome the King of Glory and the Bridegroom to come and prepare the Bride. You have the anointing of John the Baptist.”

    And we are experiencing the birth of a ‘healing movement in the land’ focused on apostolic discipleship, the fivefold call to go, preach the gospel of the kingdom, and make disciples. We are submitting each season to the leadership of the Holy Spirit and are open to His leading. I believe we have already started on 22nd April 2026, planting a ‘house to house’ network of small groups. These are anointed places that become hubs for God’s dwelling presence, where people are saved, baptised in the water, the Holy Spirit and fire, healed, restored, encouraged, and receive their spiritual breakthroughs.

    To align with the apostolic model in the Book of Acts, we must return to the practices of the first-century church. The apostolic church gathered primarily in homes, which served as the structural foundation of family and community. It was in an upper room, a home, that 120 believers, ‘disciples-ministers’, waited with anticipation to fulfil their apostolic calling. Jesus instructed His disciples not to rely on their own strength or talents, but to wait for the promise of the Father: the Holy Spirit.

    The New Testament documents the church meeting in homes at least 13 times, such as Acts 2:46, “So continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, they ate their food with gladness and simplicity of heart.” Clearly, we could see that throughout the Scriptures the believers were moving from house to house, breaking bread, praying, and ministering the Word. After the believers gathered in public places like the temple, they used these opportunities to witness to the crowds, demonstrating the power of the Gospel of the Kingdom openly. This resulted in 3,000 people being saved (Acts 2:41) followed by 5,000 (Acts 4:4).

    We are praying for the believers to rise up and come along with us to plan an apostolic centre, the “Antioch Model”, across 77 provinces as the ‘Lampstand, the apostolic and prophetic foundation’, since we are “built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ Himself being the chief cornerstone, in whom the whole building, being fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord, in whom you also are being built together for a dwelling place of God in the Spirit.” Our hearts are burning with new oil and fresh fire and preparing for Christ’s second coming by preaching the Gospel of the Kingdom of God.

    He will also go before Him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just, to make ready a people prepared for the Lord. Luke 1:17

    “Strong prophet of the end times that God has raised you up. Strong prophet, a precious prophet that God has risen up with a pure heart and also boldness of spirit that you fear no man…”

    “You are not here to please anyone; you have seen powerful people, you have no fear of evil people in religious high places. You will speak prophetic Word that will enter the hearts of the people because ‘you don’t go around the bush’. You must release the Word. I see people have to either repent to the Word or they have to reject the Word. They simply can’t stay neutral through the Word that should be released from your mouth, and the Word comes with great fire. I see your mouth full of fire when you release the Word with fire; it will burn the hearts, it will cost them to repent, to be radically saved and transformed and on fire for God. The Lord will send you to places, key cities turn nations around as you release the Word under prophetic unction upon you.

    It is very interesting like three of you (my spiritual mother and friend were standing behind me, both from Singapore) the Lord is saying to you right now. Yes, you need people standing with you, covering you in the covenant relationship. The covenant relationship is where their protection is. Covenant to walking with you. There are people that God will bring to you that are willing to die for you and you for them as well. Such is the covenant so that an enemy can’t do anything when caught not to be divided. This unity, this unity is enough to break every work of the enemy.

    I am just sensing that the Light of the Father is upon you. I am sensing His joy over you. I said to you, My son, I have taken you from where you know, I took you from the dark places and I put you in the bright light of glory to be burning MY NAME (YHVH) in places that represent Me. I need people whom I can trust to represent Me fully. I heard the Father say, ‘You are one of them that I have chosen to represent Me. He delights over you.’ The Lord’s hand of blessing and protection is over you, your wife, and all state of affairs, the mountain, ha ha ha; I see the glory on the mountains. I see the glory on the mountains! Oh, this prayer mountain, people will visit this prayer mountain, they will catch the fire and such a revelation. It is not just for Thailand; it is for the nations. Revelations flowing like a mighty river.

    I see the angel Michael standing over Thailand and Myanmar. Their destiny is related together. Just like Singapore, Malaysia, and Indonesia. Thailand, Myanmar, and Laos are connected. I see that the angelic host has an assignment to this region right now to effect rapid change. Indochina shall become most prospered. Fast-growing area in His mighty name of Jesus.”

    Rosh Hashanah 2017

    On September 21st, 2017 (Heb. Rosh Hashanah 5778), we began focusing on the weekly prayer altar and weekly believers’ fellowship called Philadelphia ‘Brotherly Love’ International Remnant Fellowship. The revolutionary Scripture in that season came from Revelation 3:7–13 and Isaiah 22:22. The emphasis here is on the irreversible permanence of what is accomplished. Once open, no man can shut it. Once shut, no man can open it (Isaiah 60:1–3, James 1:17, 2 Chronicles 7:14). During a prayer meeting marked by deep repentance for their sins, they recognised that the kingdom is at hand and the Heavenly Father spoke,

    “Build Me a dwelling place where I can rest in your midst.”

    The same year, a book written by Tom Hess, Seek First the Kingdom, was translated into the Thai language by our ministry team.

    An Open Vision of Five Large Fish on Doi Inthanon Mountain and the Revelation of the Five-fold Ministry in Thailand

    On January 26–27th, 2019, we went with the Kingdom family to Doi Inthanon Mountain, the highest mountain in Thailand, for the prayer summit. The next day, early morning, I went for my prayer walk to the woods and, as I walked, I found a spot to sit down. As I prayed in the spirit language and meditated on God’s word, I beheld an open vision. “I found myself looking under the water; the water was very clean and clear, fresh, and at that moment I was reminded of the Holy Spirit as the water of life.

    And he showed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding from the throne of God and of the Lamb. Revelation 22:1

    Before my eyes, one by one, the Big Five wonderfully looking fish began to appear. They were healthy and beautifully coloured with rainbow hues. Five large fish were perfectly connected, their bodies forming a single entity. Beneath them, numerous smaller fish swam in submission, creating a striking image of perfect unity within God’s creation.” Shortly afterwards, sister Olga from the Philippines shared the prophetic message she received during our prayer time. She said,

    “God has the big picture. God allows and enables us to see and be part of it. There is a marriage happening. It is not the marriage of the Lamb. It is a marriage covenant of pioneers/apostles, seers/prophets, pastors/shepherds, teachers, and evangelists. For too long, they have kept each other at arm’s length. But the Lord has reckoned it a while back. As the world’s agenda is moving… God’s agenda is advancing even greater. He is coming with the weight of glory only a whole and healthy Bride can hold. God requires and needs them as one. Cover the Four Corners (North, East, West, South) and anoint its pillars. Pray for the church leaders.”

    The Prophetic Word, Activation, and Commissioning That Has Influenced My Life and Ministry

    On June 26th, 2021, during the School of the Prophets hosted by Dr. Annette Wright from the School of the Prophets OPI in Atlanta, Georgia, USA, Dr. Bill Hamon did a prophet activation and delivered a prophetic word to me saying,

    “Expect more than you have been expecting, believe in the supernatural.”

    “Because you are moving to your supernatural realms, you’ve got the training and knowledge, but the Lord said, let Me convert your coffee grinds to coffee, which means from knowledge to workability. Now, God said that I will take all the knowledge that I have given you and convert it into keepability and demonstrate it. Therefore, start doing what you have been preaching and preach the supernatural until you start believing your preaching, and people start believing that they are getting their miracles…”

    “Because from now on, it’s going to take miracles to breakthrough in this next dimension in all new areas. There are demons bigger than you have ever faced before, but GOD says I am empowering you like you never were before, and you are going to speak with the words of faith, you are going to decree, you are going to know that you have got the power to put the biggest demon in hell, and you are going to lead people in warfare; they will go against the enemy, and GOD said, ‘I am going to tear down the strongholds. I am going to open doors that no missionary has ever opened before, and you are going to be bold with the word to top leaders, and you are going to have the word for the people.

    My son, all that I had promised you, all that you had in visions, maybe they are just “daydreaming”; it will come to pass. It was My Spirit, it was My anointing, and I anoint you now! and I appoint you now! to be My voice, and I backed you up to speak My Word with demonstration. You speak My Word, and I will heal the sick, I will cast out devils, heal the oppressed, I will make a way where there was no way, as the prayer of the saints is going forward strong and moving. You are my instrument to get the job done, rise and be a man of faith, be the man of boldness, be the man of miracles with signs and wonders, and I will fulfil all that I promised you, and I will take care of the finances, I will take care of the people, I will take care of the situations.’ You just do what I tell you to do, and I will take care of all the rest, saith the LORD. Amen. Hallelujah, you have the anointing over there.”

    Empowering and Commissioning the Apostolic Team with the Holy Spirit’s Fire to Establish “Fire Starters Schools”

    Empowering and commissioning the apostolic team with the Holy Spirit’s fire to establish “Fire Starters Schools”.

    Our Thai team hosted the Refiner’s Fire Revival conference at Lanna Palace Hotel, Prayer Tower on the 14th floor in Chiang Mai from July 25–27, 2018. Jesus Christ ignited His Bride’s passion and fervour in faith, preparing His people to serve and reign now and in the Kingdom to come. About half a year later, on February 18–24, 2019, two of us attended the first Fire Starters School in Singapore.

    On December 11th, 2021, the Apostolic Mission from Singapore, led by Dr. Paul Ang and Apostle Joshua Tan, along with other leadership from the nations of New Zealand, Australia, Malaysia, and America, ordained and commissioned us as an “apostolic team”, to partner in preparing and conducting “The Fire Starters Schools” in Chiang Mai, Khon Kaen, Kanchanaburi, Hat Yai, Bangkok, two in Korat, east of Thailand, and one in East Malaysia, Miri, Sarawak.

    In total, approximately over 800 students were impacted, received the spiritual impartation, were touched, activated, and released into their callings. It is encouraging to see that these ministries continue to grow and multiply among their communities. That season, ending in 2025 with the 7th AOF Fire Starters School, has concluded. We give all the glory, honour, praise, and thanksgiving to the Almighty God, His Beloved Son Jesus, the Messiah, and the Holy Spirit. He has worked gracefully for us.

    Philadelphia Apostolic Mission Centre, Chiang Mai, Thailand

    Seven years later, the Philadelphia Apostolic Mission Centre (PAMC) was officially launched in Chiang Mai on February 22, 2024, by Thai Apostolic Church, Beth of Victory of Korat, East of Thailand. Since then, we have focused on hosting the apostolic and prophetic movement to make disciples for Christ and plant “church homes” to serve as His witnesses within the local community across various ethnic groups. Additionally, we are hosting prophetic intensive trainings and have expanded our outreach internationally.

    God is doing something new in Thailand and beyond, as the prophet Isaiah proclaimed, saying,

    Do not remember the former things, nor consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing, now it shall spring forth; shall you not know it? I will even make a road in the wilderness and rivers in the desert. Isaiah 43:18–19

    Dr. Bill Hamon has written in his book Apostles, Prophets and the Coming Moves of God,

    “May the Lamb that was slain receive the reward of His suffering.”

    About

    Statement of Faith

    A non-denominational ministry in Thailand under the apostolic and prophetic anointing, with Jesus Christ as our Head, Chief Apostle and Cornerstone.

    Our Mission

    Our great commission is to proclaim the Gospel of the Kingdom to everyone through all available means in this 21st century. Equipping the saints to carry out this work is equally vital, as Jesus Christ, the Chief Apostle, taught. God created and sustains all things through His Word, as described in Genesis 1 and Hebrews. Isaiah 55:10–11 emphasises that His Word achieves its purpose and doesn’t return empty, demonstrating its transformative power.

    The Authority of the Holy Bible

    We believe the Bible is God-inspired and should be the authoritative rule of life and practice for all Christians. We believe the Scriptures can be fulfilled and must not be broken. The Old Testament was a type and shadow of better things to come, while the New Testament is the perfect expression of God’s will and character as revealed through Jesus Christ. The Epistles express what Christ has done for us and desires to do through us.

    2 Timothy 3:16–17; Hebrews 1:1–3; John 10:35; Matthew 5:19, 19:17; 1 John 2:3–4

    The Eternal Godhead

    We believe God is Triune: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit are equally Divine and therefore equally deity.

    1 John 5:7–8; Matthew 1:20–25; 2 Corinthians 13:14

    Man & Original Purpose

    We believe man was created in the image of God and his purpose was to have dominion over all the works of God’s hands.

    Genesis 1:26

    Spirit Beings: Satan, Demons and Angels

    We believe in a literal Satan, Lucifer, the adversary of God and humanity, and the prince of the power of the air. We also believe in spirit beings known as demons and angels.

    1 Peter 5:8; Matthew 8:16; Mark 16:17; Ephesians 2:2; Hebrews 1:7, 13–14

    The Fall of Man

    We believe man fell from God’s perfection through voluntary disobedience and independence, as described in Romans 5:12.

    Sin

    We believe anything not born of faith is sin. Our sins have been forgiven and not imputed to us. We believe Jesus Christ, our advocate with the Father, cleanses us of all unrighteousness.

    Romans 4:8, 6:14, 14:23; 1 John 1:9–2:1

    The Miracle of Salvation

    We believe Christ died for us while we were still sinners, securing pardon for all who believe in Him. Since we have no righteousness of our own, we must come to God pleading Christ’s righteousness as our only justification.

    John 3:16; Romans 5:8; Ephesians 2:8

    Sanctification

    We believe Christ is our sanctification. We are sanctified upon receiving Him and grow in grace as we grow in Christ, ever increasing in holiness of life.

    1 Corinthians 1:30; 1 Thessalonians 4:3; 2 Thessalonians 2:13; 1 Peter 1:2; 2 Peter 3:18

    Water, Holy Spirit “Born Again” and Fire Immersion/Baptism

    We believe in water baptism by full immersion, distinct from the new birth. The Baptism of the Holy Spirit is experienced through speaking in tongues as the Spirit of God speaks through the gifts of the Spirit, accompanied by the evidence of the fruit of the Spirit.

    Matthew 3:11; Luke 3:16–17, 17:20–21; John 3:1–8; Acts 2:4; Romans 6:1–4

    Empowered by the Holy Spirit

    We believe the Holy Spirit empowers believers to live a life pleasing to God, do Christ’s works and meet the needs of all humanity.

    John 14:12, 16:7–16; Luke 4:18, 24:49; Acts 1:8, 10:38; 1 Corinthians 12–14

    Divine Healing

    We believe healing is a result of Christ’s atonement, with Divine Healing being God’s power to heal the sick. We believe Christ’s atoning sacrifice included healing for everyone and it’s God’s will for every Christian to minister healing to anyone at any time.

    Psalm 103:2; Isaiah 53:3–4; Matthew 8:16–17; 1 Peter 2:24; John 14:12

    The Church

    We believe the Church, Christ’s Body, comprises all those in whom the Spirit of Christ dwells. It’s the earthly body of Christ, meant to grow into Him in all things.

    Romans 8:9; Ephesians 1:23, 4:11–16

    Ministry Gifts and Oversight

    We believe God has designated and equipped duly called and qualified individuals to function as overseers of the Body of Christ on earth. These individuals are tasked with equipping and edifying the saints until the church has grown into the image of Christ.

    Ephesians 4:11–15; 1 Corinthians 12:28; Acts 20:28; 1 Peter 5:1–3

    Judgement

    We believe God’s judgement has been passed to Jesus. While there will be a day of judgement and eternal separation, we also believe judgement begins at God’s house, as consequences for decisions made outside His will.

    1 Peter 4:17

    Faith

    Our faith is based on God’s promises and trusting His faithfulness in fulfilling them. It rests in God’s Word, not our own, and we believe in His unwavering Word.

    Mark 11:22–23; Hebrews 6:1, 11:1; 2 Timothy 2:13

    Grace and Repentance from Dead Works

    We believe in grace and repentance from dead works. Jesus Christ’s grace is available to everyone, offering the chance to repent and turn to Him for sin remission. Repentance from dead works involves abandoning any actions that might seem to earn favour or salvation from God.

    John 1:16–17; Romans 11:6; Hebrews 6:1, 9:14

    The Kingdom of God

    We believe the Kingdom of God is what Jesus preached and demonstrated, and we’re called to continue His ministry with the same results. We also believe we should spread the Kingdom of God on earth until Christ invites us to join Him in His eternal Heaven.

    Mark 1:35–39; Luke 4:42–44; Matthew 4:23–25; Luke 9:60–10:11; Acts 8:12, 19:8, 20:25; 1 Corinthians 4:20; 2 Thessalonians 1:5; Matthew 25:19–23

    The One New Man

    We believe in the unity of all people, Jew and Gentile, in Christ.

    We believe in “the One New Man” and that Jesus Christ abolished the barrier between Jews and Gentiles. Through the blood of the cross, He united them into a single, unified humanity. Both groups form a single born-again Body of Messiah and household of God, retaining their distinct identities while sharing equally in the Messiah’s inheritance.

    “I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ, for it is the power of God to salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first and also for the Greek.” Romans 1:16

    Deuteronomy 32:21; John 4:22; Ephesians 2:14–18; Romans 1:16, 11:11–36

    The Second Coming of Jesus Christ

    We believe in Jesus Christ’s Second Coming as our blessed eternal hope for His Church. This involves the personal and visible return of our glorified King Jesus. This prophecy is fulfilled in Revelation 19 after the “marriage supper of the Lamb”, when heaven opens and Christ descends to Earth on a white horse for Armageddon. His Bride, the armies clad in white linen, will follow. This event marks the resurrection of the righteous, including “Old Testament saints and friends” of Christ, who will participate in the Millennium on Earth. It also signifies the transformation of believers and the final establishment of God’s eternal kingdom.

    Matthew 24:26–31, 36–44; Luke 21:25–28; John 5:28–29, 14:1–3; 1 Thessalonians 4:16–17, 5:1–3; 1 Corinthians 15:51–52; Revelation 1:7, 19; Daniel 12:2; Hebrews 9:27–28

    Our Mission Statement

    Our mission is to spread the Gospel of the Kingdom of God, demonstrating its power and inviting others to join us in its mission. We believe the Christian mission is to love God in thought, word, and deed, and to love your neighbour as yourself. This is shown by doing unto them as you would have them do unto you. Your love for God and man will be evident in your efforts to reproduce disciples of Jesus Christ both domestically and internationally, using every Biblical method. The Holy Spirit gives all the glory to Jesus Christ and brings fulfilment through the Great Commission:

    Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature. He who believes and is baptised shall be saved; but he who believes not shall be damned. And these signs shall follow them who believe: In my name they shall cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues; they shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover. Mark 16:15–18

    Matthew 7:11–29, 28:18–20; Mark 16:15–18; Ephesians 2:20, 4:11–14; Acts 2:17, 3:19–21, 6:4, 10:38; Hebrews 1:7

    Our non-denominational ministry in Thailand operates under the apostolic and prophetic anointing with Jesus Christ as our Head, Chief Apostle, and Cornerstone. We’re committed to prayer and the ministry of the Word as instructed in Acts 6:4, and witnessing the restoration of all things as God has spoken through all His holy prophets since the world began. Guided by God’s grace and the Holy Spirit’s leading, our team is spreading the Gospel of the Kingdom within 77 provinces and beyond, equipping ministers to fulfil God’s mission as “His ministers are a flame of fire”. The Holy Spirit is preparing saints for a greater manifestation of God’s Word and His holy presence in these final days, known as the latter rain.

    Faithful Partnership & Eternal Purpose

    Kingdom Alliances

    In the Scripture, kingdom alliances are binding relationships formed for mutual purpose, protection, and cooperation. While often established for political, military, or social reasons, every alliance was measured by one standard: faithfulness to God’s covenant.

    The Bible presents both wise and unwise alliances. God blessed partnerships that advanced His purposes and reflected His righteousness, such as those made by Abraham and David. However, alliances that compromised worship, encouraged idolatry, or placed trust in human power rather than God brought spiritual decline and judgment, as seen in the reigns of Solomon, Ahab, and other kings.

    The biblical principle remains clear: every kingdom alliance should be built on truth, integrity, and obedience to God. Genuine partnerships strengthen God’s people, promote His mission, and advance His kingdom, while compromising alliances weaken spiritual life and distract from God’s calling.

    David & Jonathan Kingdom Alliances

    Both shared a truly unique and beautiful alliance. Their connection transcended the ordinary, allowing them to meet and communicate in the spirit realm unlike any other. As soul friends, they experienced a wonderful sensitivity and closeness stemming from God-made alliances. Perfect understanding and trust flourished between them, transcending familial ties. Their hearts were open, fostering an environment where nothing was hidden. They felt safe and secure with each other. Jonathan, as the son of King Saul, had the right to the throne, yet acknowledged the divine call upon David’s life as the next king of Israel. He made the covenant alliances. Jonathan submitted himself to the will of the Almighty and gave away the armour and the throne to David.

    Now when he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was knit to the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul. Saul took him that day, and would not let him go home to his father’s house anymore. Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul. And Jonathan took off the robe that was on him and gave it to David, with his armor, even to his sword and his bow and his belt. So David went out wherever Saul sent him, and behaved wisely. And Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people and also in the sight of Saul’s servants. 1 Samuel 18:1–5

    School of the Prophets of Fire

    Raising a prophetic generation that hears the voice of God and carries His word with accuracy.

    Apply now

    The school equips students with full authority for end-time ministry in practical and supernatural ways. Its teaching follows the biblical pattern of fatherhood and sonship, Moses to Joshua and Elijah to Elisha, passing on experience and knowledge through spiritual impartation, as Jesus did with the twelve and Paul with Timothy.

    "Build Me an army of prophets proclaiming the Scriptures."

    The word of the Lord to W.D. Peter, 1 May 2026

    The school's purpose is to equip workers and commission them to advance the Kingdom of God. "No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God" (Luke 9:62).

    Prayer of a Minor Prophet

    The prayer of A.W. Tozer at his ordination, quoted in Warren W. Wiersbe's The Best of A.W. Tozer (pp. 77–79), with 2 Chronicles 20:20–21. It acknowledges God's call and the speaker's unfitness, asks for discernment against false shepherds, and for protection from compromise, professionalism, crowd-chasing and love of publicity. At its centre is the plea to be anointed with the oil of the New Testament prophet, a prophet and not a promoter, dedicating every remaining day to God's will.

    Prophetic Calling for a New Generation

    In Elijah's day God kept seven thousand in Israel who had not bowed the knee to Baal (1 Kings 19:18). The school prays for a new generation, seven thousand new knees in Israel, the United States and the nations, that will bow to the King of kings, Jesus Christ (Philippians 2:10), and stand against the spirits of Baal and Jezebel.

    This school of the prophets is zealous for the Lord and His Word, committed to proclaiming salvation and standing firm until the Lord returns. It honours Yeshua as "The Prophet" (Deuteronomy 18:15; John 6:14; Luke 24:19).

    YHVH has created a new, God-fearing prophetic generation that lives apart from the spirit of the world, confronting the spirits of Ahab and Jezebel through holy living rather than politics or human alliances, united in Yeshua against every form of ethnic, religious or national segregation (Hebrews 3).

    Tabernacle of David · Chiang Mai, Thailand

    TOD: House of Prayer for All Nations

    The Tabernacle of David we are raising up in the city of Chiang Mai, a house of prayer for all nations.

    Jesus Christ is working as the Chief Apostle and Great High Priest to purify His holy community into a house of prayer for all nations. This generation is witnessing His revolutionary holy worshippers rising up to overcome the world through Jesus Christ, who is seated at the right hand of God and making intercession for the saints, to overcome the world with a powerful prayer and end-times harvest of souls movement, and a centre for signs and wonders to all nations.

    Christ came as High Priest of the good things to come, with the greater and more perfect tabernacle not made with hands, that is, not of this creation. Not with the blood of goats and calves, but with His own blood He entered the Most Holy Place once for all, having obtained eternal redemption. Hebrews 9:11–12

    The Bible gives three main references to the tabernacle of David: Isaiah 16:5, Amos 9:11 and Acts 15:16–17, in which the apostle James repeats the prophet Amos’s prophecy over 200 years after David’s death, saying,

    ‘After this I will return and will rebuild the tabernacle of David, which has fallen down; I will rebuild its ruins, and I will set it up; so that the rest of mankind may seek the LORD, even all the Gentiles who are called by My name,’ says the LORD who does all these things. Acts 15:16–17

    The Purpose and Objectives of the TOD

    The primary reason for restoring the Tabernacle of David is that Beloved King Jesus has made us kings and priests to His Heavenly Father, with unlimited love and power (Revelation 1:5–6). The purpose of the king is to rule and reign with Christ, the Anointed Messiah, who occupied the regions with the advance of the Kingdom of God; and the purpose of the priest is to have unveiled intimacy and worship.

    The Hebrew word translated ‘tabernacle’ is ohel, which means a tent, covering, dwelling place or home. The word mishkan is another word for the dwelling place of God amongst His people Israel.

    The Call for TOD

    Around the world is a call to “raise the Tabernacle of David”. This has been gathering momentum in prayer, praise, worship and proclamation of Scripture for several decades. It is a sound that is growing stronger and louder, bringing the generations together: Jewish and Gentile people as One New Man in Christ, coming into the revelation of being a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy Kingdom nation. It is all as the Heavenly Father has spoken through His holy apostles and prophets.

    In 1 Peter 2:7–10, He spoke through the apostle Peter, saying,

    “Therefore, to you who believe, He is precious; but to those who are disobedient, ‘The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,’ and ‘A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense.’ They stumble, being disobedient to the word, to which they also were appointed. But you are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, His own special people, that you may proclaim the praises of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvellous light; who once were not a people but are now the people of God, who had not obtained mercy but now have obtained mercy.” 1 Peter 2:7–10

    Through this passage we can clearly see that the purpose of raising David’s Tabernacle is evangelism: bringing multitudes of souls, Jews and Gentiles, into the Kingdom of God, and releasing the rivers of life and the mighty power of the Holy Spirit into the nations of the earth, bringing salvation and healing wherever they flow.

    Missions

    Rescue Children Mission

    And if you draw out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall your light rise in darkness, and your darkness shall be as the noonday. Isaiah 58:10

    Most people do not understand what trafficking is. Here is the official description I found:

    Human trafficking is the commerce and trade in the movement or migration of people, legal and illegal, including both legitimate labor activities as well as forced labor. The term is used in a more narrow sense by advocacy groups to mean the recruitment, transportation, harboring, or receipt of people for the purposes of slavery, prostitution, forced labor (including bonded labor or debt bondage), and servitude.

    Trafficking victims typically are recruited using coercion, deception, fraud, the abuse of power, or outright abduction. Exploitation includes forcing people into prostitution or other forms of sexual exploitation, forced labor or services, slavery or practices similar to slavery and servitude. For children, exploitation may also include forced prostitution, illicit international adoption, trafficking for early marriage, or recruitment as child soldiers, beggars, for sports (such as child camel jockeys or football players), or within certain religious groups.

    What is on our heart is that we need to:

    • Intercede on behalf of the weak, broken, downcast, widows and orphans
    • Pray the Lord will break in with light and expose the darkness of human trafficking, and the recruiters and traffickers be brought to justice
    • Pray the Lord will break in with truth and that justice will prevail
    • Pray for the ending of human trafficking, and for corruption in the local police and government to be exposed
    • Pray for safe homes and aftercare ministries: for funding, wisdom, protection and help
    • Pray for the rescued: for inner healing, salvation and a life of freedom
    • Pray for protection for children and families that are vulnerable due to their situations (poor, hungry, etc.)
    • Sponsorship for children in Southern Asia: Thailand, Burma, Laos, Cambodia, Vietnam, India…

    The poor are exploited: recruiters capitalize on vulnerable situations. There need to be solutions to educate the poor about trafficking and to provide ways for the poor to earn money rather than selling their children or forcing their children to beg. So many children are treated as commodities. They are sold so that the parents receive money to purchase food, or even to purchase a home or a television!

    Traffickers use false promises to lure the children from their families. Children are beaten, raped and lied to in order to keep them from running. Violence is used to imprint the slaveholder’s dominance on the child. Shame is used to keep the children from running back to their village.

    Human trafficking brings profits to many economic sectors. A child would not “choose” the repeated trauma of 10 or more grown men penetrating their bodies every evening. This is not a choice… this is rape!

    It starts with the owner of a business offering a loan to the family and then a job. Possibly the job is in a rice mill or making bricks, etc. The family or individual signs a contract which most often they cannot read. The contract states how much they will make per day and that interest is charged on the loan (at large amounts). They will NEVER pay this loan off.

    The men (“Johns”) in country and from other countries need to stop wanting to have sex with these children. Women are involved most often as recruiters in this industry. The issue seems so BIG, but I know that our God, through His people, is capable of miracles.

    The Office of the Apostles

    In the divine structure of ministry, each office plays a unique and vital role in advancing the Kingdom of God.

    The Apostle as the Thumb of the Hand

    The apostle, often symbolized as the thumb on the hand, represents connection, strength, and versatility. Just as the thumb enables the hand to function effectively by working in harmony with the other fingers, the apostle connects and empowers the various ministries within the body of Christ.

    The Apostle serves as the thumb on the hand, connecting all the fingers and unlocking the key to all ministries. This symbolic representation highlights the apostle’s ability to work alongside every other office—prophets, evangelists, shepherds, and teachers—bringing unity and coordination to the work of the Church. Without the thumb, the hand’s grip is weak; likewise, without the apostolic office, the Church’s structure lacks cohesion and strength.

    Building the Kingdom of God

    Equipped with the necessary skills and abilities, the apostle plays a crucial role in successfully building the Kingdom of God. Apostles are visionaries and pioneers, often called to establish new works, plant churches, and lay spiritual foundations where none previously existed. Their leadership and discernment guide others toward fulfilling God’s divine purpose, ensuring that every ministry operates in alignment with His will.

    Collaboration with Other Ministries

    The primary function of the apostle is to collaborate with prophets, evangelists, shepherds, teachers, deacons, and helpers of ministry. This collaboration extends to administrators, elders, and even government officials within the Church. The apostle’s role is not one of isolation but of partnership—bringing together diverse gifts and callings to function as one unified body. Through this cooperation, the Church becomes a living, breathing organism that reflects the fullness of Christ’s ministry on earth.

    Shepherding and Oversight

    An apostle has the potential to become a shepherd or pastor overseeing churches they have planted. This pastoral dimension allows them to nurture and guide the congregations they have established, ensuring that each church remains rooted in sound doctrine and spiritual maturity. Their oversight provides stability and continuity, fostering growth and accountability within the body of believers.

    Apostolic Abilities and Spiritual Gifts

    The apostolic calling is marked by a range of abilities that serve the Church and the world. Apostles are often gifted in evangelising the lost, teaching people the Word of God, and discerning the voice of God with clarity and authority. These abilities enable them to lead effectively, inspire faith, and equip others for ministry. Their discernment ensures that the Church remains sensitive to the leading of the Holy Spirit and responsive to God’s direction.

    The Office of the Apostles stands as a cornerstone in the divine order of ministry. Like the thumb that strengthens and connects the hand, the apostle unites and empowers the various offices within the Church. Through vision, collaboration, and spiritual authority, apostles play a foundational role in building and sustaining the Kingdom of God on earth.
